<issue>
Bug: parquet-java fails on unknown logical types
parquet-java fails while parsing file metadata when the schema contains an unknown logical type, instead of treating the column according to its underlying physical type.

See apache/parquet-format#599 for the background, test files, affected versions, and expected behavior.

Related: #2709 and #3633.

</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

input.instruction: In /testbed (parquet-java), find where parquet-format LogicalType thrift union is converted to LogicalTypeAnnotation in ParquetMetadataConverter (getLogicalTypeAnnotation(LogicalType) and schema conversion from SchemaElement). Report the code of getLogicalTypeAnnotation method with line numbers, and where it's called (buildChildren etc.), including how unknown union (e.g. null/unset field) is handled.

content.content: {"summary":"In ParquetMetadataConverter, the thrift LogicalType union is mapped to LogicalTypeAnnotation by getLogicalTypeAnnotation(LogicalType) at line 1345. It switches on type.getSetField(). The only caller that reads the union from a SchemaElement is buildChildren (line 2028), which guards every use with isSetLogicalType(). An unset or null union is therefore skipped on the read path, and the converter itself never passes a null LogicalType in. The reverse direction (LogicalTypeAnnotation to LogicalType) is at lines 320-322 and 350-352.","findings":["parquet-hadoop/src/main/java/org/apache/parquet/format/converter/ParquetMetadataConverter.java:1345-1392: `LogicalTypeAnnotation getLogicalTypeAnnotation(LogicalType type)` does `switch (type.getSetField())` and returns the matching LogicalTypeAnnotation factory for MAP, BSON, DATE, ENUM, JSON, LIST, TIME, STRING, DECIMAL, INTEGER, UNKNOWN, TIMESTAMP, UUID, FLOAT16, GEOMETRY, GEOGRAPHY and VARIANT. The default branch (line 1389-1390) throws RuntimeException(\"Unknown logical type \" + type).","Unset or null union handling: `type.getSetField()` returns null when no union member is set, and switching on null throws NullPointerException. The method has no null check and no fallback to null. Callers avoid this by checking isSetLogicalType() first.","ParquetMetadataConverter.java:1291: the overload `getLogicalTypeAnnotation(ConvertedType type, SchemaElement schemaElement)` handles the legacy converted_type path.","ParquetMetadataConverter.java:2015-2026: `fromParquetSchema(List<SchemaElement>, List<ColumnOrder>)` calls `buildChildren(builder, iterator, root.getNum_children(), ...)` at line 2024 for the root.","ParquetMetadataConverter.java:2028-2085: `buildChildren` iterates over childrenCount SchemaElements. For primitives (schemaElement.type != null) it builds a primitive builder. Otherwise it recurses into buildChildren for the group's num_children (line 2065).","ParquetMetadataConverter.java:2068-2070: `if (schemaElement.isSetLogicalType()) childBuilder.as(getLogicalTypeAnnotation(schemaElement.logicalType));` — the only call site of the LogicalType overload on the read path, guarded so unset unions are skipped.","ParquetMetadataConverter.java:2071-2085: converted_type handling. Under isSetConverted_type() it computes originalType from the ConvertedType overload and newOriginalType from the logical type (lines 2074-2076, guarded by isSetLogicalType() and a null check). On mismatch it logs a warning (LOG.warn, \"Converted type and logical type metadata mismatch\") and uses the converted type via childBuilder.as(originalType).","Write path: ParquetMetadataConverter.java:320-322 (primitive) and 350-352 (group) call convertToLogicalType(LogicalTypeAnnotation) and set schema element logicalType when getLogicalTypeAnnotation() != null."],"confidence":0.85}

content.text:
An unknown logical type no longer makes `ParquetMetadataConverter` throw. The column is read using its underlying physical type, plus its `converted_type` if one is set. I haven't compiled or tested this, and I didn't add a test file.

- **`getLogicalTypeAnnotation(LogicalType)`:** the default branch now logs a warning and returns `null` instead of throwing `RuntimeException("Unknown logical type ...")`.
- **`buildChildren`:** it only calls `childBuilder.as(...)` when the annotation is non-null. The converted-type check below it already handled a `null` annotation, so I left it alone.

I haven't confirmed that the thrift deserializer in parquet-format itself accepts an unknown union member. It may skip the field and leave the union unset, which this code already tolerates. If it throws first, the fix has to go in parquet-format, and this change alone won't be enough. The test files from apache/parquet-format#599 would settle it.
